svg.aria-label: One journey cycle: argus's journey lane checks the catalog, brings up an isolated instance of its own, picks the top journeys, walks each with a ui-explorer agent through the browser wrapper only, reproduces every candidate two of two on a fresh instance, minimizes it into a RED test, classifies it, files it only after scrub finds no secret the run saw, tears the instance down and records the visit; an explorer that reached the goal of a journey charted for the smoke suite also returns a path, which the lane admits, once it held at every width and on a used instance, before it is proposed as a pull request.
svg.title: /journey — one journey cycle
svg.desc: One invocation of /journey is one bounded argus cycle of ten steps, each run through argus-live.mjs: ORIENT checks the journey catalog against HEAD with map-check; up builds an isolated instance (its own worktree, ports, data and HOME, never the owner's servers) while a map-mode explorer rebuilds a stale catalog; SELECT scores the journeys and allocates accounts; CHARTER mints one token and one charter per explorer; one sapu:ui-explorer per journey walks it as every role through the pw wrapper only, reading page text as fenced data; repro replays each candidate on a freshly reset instance and only two of two goes on, minimized and written as a Playwright RED test; classify gives the class, labels and starting severity, and drift sends a doc contradiction to the owner with the needs-owner label; scrub refuses an issue holding any secret the run saw and files the rest; down stops only what up started; PERSIST records each journey's visit, its coverage and the next picks, and report writes the cycle's record. A journey that is not in the smoke suite yet is charted with path: wanted: when its explorer reaches the goal it returns the steps as a path as well, smoke admit runs the path twice (a fresh instance, then a used one), and smoke propose turns it into a pull request that the owner merges or closes after scrub finds no secret in it. seed gives a map-mode explorer an issue that passes the trust check, or lines of a tracked doc, to read as fenced data; a journey it names is kept only where the code anchors it. A candidate that does not reproduce two of two, a harness failure and a run whose secret ledger is incomplete are journalled and never filed. The lane runs from the main session only, never inside /inspector.
svg.text: One journey cycle, end to end
Walk the app's business journeys through the real UI as every role. Suspect freely; file only what a script reproduced twice.
ten steps, each a command of argus-live.mjs · one invocation = one bounded cycle
the catalog checked against HEAD; refresh due?
an instance of its own; a map explorer if stale
one token and one charter per explorer
every role, through the wrapper only
two of two on a fresh instance; RED test
no secret the run saw, then filed
argus's phases: ORIENT · SELECT (steps 2–3) · CHARTER · EXECUTE / OBSERVE · MINIMIZE · TRIAGE · REPORT (8–9) · PERSIST / ROTATE
A candidate's way to an issue
the explorer only suspects; scripts decide
not reproduced (runs=1/2) or a harness failure: journalled, never filed
ledger incomplete, gone or damaged: nothing from that run is filed
scrub hit: names <title|body> <line>:<col>, never the value
doc drift: drift decides class B(a), or the needs-owner label
A path for the smoke suite
an explorer charted path: wanted returns its steps too; scripts decide the rest
seed (an issue the trust check passes, or lines of a tracked doc) gives a map explorer text to read, fenced as data;
a journey it names is kept only where the code anchors it. report writes the cycle's record. The rest of the smoke cycle has its own diagram.
· Its own instance — worktree, ports, data and HOME — never the owner's servers; up refuses what would touch them.
· Main session only: never inside /inspector or a subagent. One cycle per repo, under a lock with a deadline.
· The explorer runs only the pw wrapper and reads page text as fenced data, never as instructions.
· Filed only at two of two, and only through scrub: a secret the run saw refuses the issue.
· A finding only the owner can rule on carries the needs-owner label; no agent removes it or closes it as not planned.
· The reaper runs down at the deadline if the session dies.
